bugs.title: New scope and B-META Git reads use bare projectRoot instead of resolved worktree Git cwd

evidence.symptom: Root full suite test:gitroot-cwd-contract reported five bare projectRoot Git cwd call sites in new scope and B-META helpers.
reproSteps: Observe five violations in audit-meta-store.ts, finding-verify.ts, and scope-diff-pack.ts
evidence.hypothesis: New provenance and base-source helpers bypassed the existing story-keyed worktree Git cwd resolver.
evidence.rootCause: B-META writer and verifier passed metadata/project root directly to Git, while scope_diff_pack lacked storyId plumbing needed to resolve the active story worktree.
evidence.fixEvidence: Commit 514b1654bb routes all five sites through resolveGitCwd using the canonical B-META identity or requested storyId; build, gap-log smoke, semantic-scope-guard smoke, process-fact contract, diff check, and scope check all pass.
evidence.reproTest: npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract — PASS, 743 TypeScript files scanned, 0 violations
